audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 gave the stage to Quinn in both layers while every one of their whys says Zaahen wins it ('your early trade tools already out-value Quinn's poke-and-reset pattern', 'your Q and E win extended trades', 'your first item bricks her falloff damage', 'you outstat and outsustain a lane bully who has nothing left in a duel').
audit.why: Quinn is a poke-and-reset lane bully whose damage falls off; a bruiser who sticks to her wins from level 2 onward. The packet chart and the mirror audit both read Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 flipped to Zaahen as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] called Zaahen's ultimate 'R Final Retribution' and gave no reason it wins the 6 spike beyond 'flips any all-in'.
audit.why: Final Retribution is not in champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json. What is in it: the R heals him for a portion of the damage dealt, on 110s at rank 1. That heal is the actual reason the level-6 all-in beats a Quinn with no combat ultimate.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten on the R heal and on Behind Enemy Lines being a non-combat channel; the fabricated name removed from spikes[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W Ominous Return', 'E Golden Onslaught' and 'R Final Retribution' are all fabricated. Vault's interrupt and its 12s cooldown, and Blinding Assault's 1025 range, were never stated.
audit.why: Riot's Vault text: she dashes to the target, slows it, 'briefly interrupting it', and lands near her maximum attack range away — so it is both a peel and an interrupt, on 12s at rank 1 at 675 range. That 12s is the window the whole page is built on and it was never given. Blinding Assault at 1025 range is why a poke war is unwinnable and walking her down is the answer.
audit.corrected: Fabricated names removed; Vault's 12s / 675 range / interrupt and Blinding Assault's 11s / 1025 range written into spikes[0], mid, wants.you[0], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t. Zaahen's W referred to as the 850-range pull, matching the mirror auditor's choice.

edits.before: Once your Q Darkin Glaive and E Golden Onslaught are online you win every extended trade: Quinn's kit is built for the Vault (E) reset and Blinding Assault (Q) auto-cancel, but neither refunds enough to survive you sticking with W Ominous Return threat and pushing through her Harrier procs.
edits.after: Once your Q and E are online you win every extended trade: Quinn's kit is built on the Vault (E) reset — 12s at rank 1, 675 range — and the Blinding Assault (Q) blind on 11s. Neither refunds enough if you stick to her, and your 850-range W pull drags her back out of the reset.

edits.before: Your R Final Retribution flips any all-in — Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines (R) is a roam/reposition tool with no lane burst, so at 6 she has no way to answer your ult commit and can only look to disengage or leave lane.
edits.after: Your R flips any all-in and heals you for a portion of the damage it deals. Behind Enemy Lines is a roam and reposition tool with no lane burst, and it is a channel — so at 6 she has no answer to your commit except to leave.

edits.before: From 3 to 6 you take over: your Q Darkin Glaive and E Golden Onslaught win any extended trade, her Vault (E) has a long cooldown to punish, and at 6 your R Final Retribution answers an all-in her non-combat ult can't match.
edits.after: From 3 to 6 you take over: your Q and E win any extended trade, Vault is 12s at rank 1 so a spent one is a real window to commit, and at 6 your R answers an all-in that her non-combat ultimate simply cannot match.

edits.before: Bait Vault (E) then punish its long cooldown
edits.after: Bait Vault (E) then punish its 12s cooldown

edits.before: - Quinn Vault: matchup-defining — Her self-peel. Burst when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vault (E): matchup-defining — 12s at rank 1, 675 range; it interrupts you and lands her back at range. Commit once it is spent. - Blinding Assault (Q): an 11s blind. - Heightened Senses (W): a 50s reveal.

edits.before: Her self-peel. Burst when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her self-peel, 12s at rank 1 — burst her down only once it is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her Q outranges you at 1025 — walk her down, never trade poke.

edits.before: Track Quinn's Vault (Dash/Blind): Her self-peel. Burst when it’s down. When it is down — Combo + R her.
edits.after: Vault is a 12s self-peel that interrupts you and lands her back at range. Her Q blind is 11s.
